claims.statement: The unrestricted universal bounded-density conjecture remains open.
A bounded continuous density for the unrestricted target remains open.

For the fleet02/B20 P2 order-two survivor with Z>1/768, E2(D)>1/48 and q_j+r_p>=23395/23171, one pair-volume orientation has a hub marginal q>=23395/46342. Mixing the anchored-third law with the pair-volume law conditioned on that physical hub at weights 1/32 and 31/32, with rho=79/80, either pays the full ambient form by a bounded continuous density <3344.877 or forces a fixed physical row/column pair with natural pair-minor mass M2>1/194.

In the resulting strict N3(1/128) M2>1/194 packet, if the fixed physical anchor edge has |d|>=1/32, its physical 2x2 principal block is indefinite with |det|>=15/16384 and sigma_min>=15/[128(sqrt(129)+1)], so the arbitrary-rank physical-pair theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<494.798.
If instead |d|<1/32, the exact deshear reserve ||dC-c r^T||_F>1/sqrt(194) implies either ||c||||r||>1/(2sqrt(194)) or ||C||_F>16/sqrt(194).

Pay the small-edge double-star or large residual physical cross-core alternatives while retaining arbitrary same-bank curvature and all ambient couplings, or route them to already proved receivers. The separate order-three deshear survivor also remains open.
